covers.text: employers in the City of Los Angeles
covers.quote: increase the minimum wage in the City of Los Angeles

applies_reason: The official summary sets $25.00 an hour for employers with 26 or more employees. The data holds 80 employees, so the $25.00 tier is used. The summary states no effective date, so the timing is unknown and the amounts are what it would cost if enacted from an unstated date.

rule.title: Minimum Wage
rule.effective_date: Not stated in the saved text
rule.quote: $25.00 per hour for employers with 26 or more employees

not_priced: The $20.00 tier is for smaller employers and does not apply: the data holds 80 employees.
Later steps ($30.00 by 2030, at least 3 percent a year after) are not priced.
The full proposed ordinance is a scanned PDF the app cannot read, so only the official summary is used.
not_priced_quotes: The minimum wage would increase to $30.00 per hour by 2030 (by 2032 for smaller employers), and at least 3% annually thereafter.
